baseline.architecture: MiniLM-L6-v2 base encoder; 6 layers; 384 output dimensions
baseline.download_bytes: approximately 90.9 MB for model.safetensors plus pinned tokenizer/config files
baseline.exposure_note: model metadata lists S2ORC and MS MARCO among training data; possible SciFact corpus overlap is unresolved and this baseline is contextual, not contamination-free evidence
baseline.loader: sentence-transformers model modules: Transformer -> mean Pooling -> Normalize
baseline.normalization: Sentence Transformers Normalize module; float32 normalized embeddings

baselines: frozen sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 revision 1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41 where local model download succeeds
evaluation.candidate_inventory: all 5,183 corpus docs, exact cosine search
evaluation.decision: a short CPU pilot can pass mechanics only; the stated quality floors are release target gates, and failure remains a measured non-promotion
evaluation.final_query_inventory: all 300 official dev queries; evaluate metrics over 188 judged queries only and publish all 300 per-query status rows

pilot.optimizer: AdamW; separate optimizer and LR schedule reset at each phase; checkpoint preserves params, first/second moments, schedule/global step, dropout/masking keys, sampler permutation/epoch/cursor, code/data/tokenizer/config/objective and parent identities

phase1_mlm.objective: selected-token cross entropy summed over selected positions and divided by selected-token count

phase2_ablation.negative_policy: other documents in the minibatch are unlabeled in-batch negatives; they are not asserted irrelevant; known human evidence positives for these weak pairs are excluded from negative slots
phase2_ablation.pair_budget: exact same 32 weak pairs, batch order and PRNG seeds in both branches
phase2_ablation.pair_selection: sort generated weak pairs by SHA256("scifact-c01-weak-pair-20261021:" + group_id + ":" + source + ":" + left_text + "\0" + right_text), take the first 32; save exact pair-ID inventory and hash
phase2_ablation.parent: phase1 MLM checkpoint for both branches
weak_pair_sources: two disjoint spans from same abstract

phase3_human_pairs.checkpoint_reset: initialize new Adam moments and phase schedule; retain parent model parameters and complete parent lineage
phase3_human_pairs.negative_policy: mask all known evidence positives from negative slots; remaining unlabeled in-batch documents are unjudged candidates, not proven negatives
phase3_human_pairs.objective: multi-positive supervised in-batch contrastive loss using only documented fit evidence IDs
phase3_human_pairs.updates_note: one deterministic pass over 281 judged fit queries at batch size 4, with a final partial batch of 1; positive union padded to 16 slots for stable shapes

pretraining_sample.eligible_doc_inventory: pretraining_doc_ids from frozen inventories; all 5,183 candidate docs minus the 295-document final-connected holdout group
pretraining_sample.mask_replacement: 80% MASK, 10% random non-special vocabulary token, 10% unchanged; keyed deterministically by epoch/document/mask-position
pretraining_sample.pilot_document_ids: select 128 eligible docs in ascending SHA256("scifact-c01-pilot-doc-20261021:" + decimal doc_id)
pretraining_sample.truncation: tail truncation after BPE; report tokens omitted

processor.fit_records: all 4,888 pretraining_doc_ids; no claim text is used to fit tokenizer
processor.normalization: none; preserve UTF-8 text and use ByteLevel pre-tokenizer
processor.exposure_disclosure: The train-only tokenizer and eligible unsupervised corpus include all 4,888 pretraining documents, including 29 documents associated with recipe-development components; the deterministic 128-document MLM sample includes 3 of those 29. Recipe-development query text and human query/evidence pairs are never training examples. This permits document-text transduction in the recipe-development population and must be considered when interpreting its metrics.

pilot.status: recipe frozen before training; bounded CPU pilot execution pending

selection.candidate_corpus: all official corpus documents; the final heldout document group remains available for ranking and is disclosed as transductive candidate exposure
selection.final: all 300 official dev claims; judged retrieval denominator is only claims with at least one documented evidence document
selection.final_heldout_documents: all cited/evidence document IDs from official dev plus every document linked through any train/final connected component; entire component is excluded from tokenizer and training
selection.grouping: connected components across original train and official dev claims sharing cited/evidence document IDs or normalized claim text; exact-normalized duplicate corpus document text grouped first; quarantine all train members of final-containing components before deterministic train-fit/train-development split
selection.human_positive: only evidence map document IDs; SUPPORT and CONTRADICT both count as evidence-retrieval relevant; cited_doc_ids alone are not positives
selection.recipe_development: SHA-256 order of whole remaining train components with seed scifact-c01-seed-20261021; add groups until at least round(10% of remaining train claims)
selection.text_normalization_for_grouping: Unicode casefold, non-word runs to spaces, collapse whitespace
selection.train_quarantine: remove every original train claim whose cited/evidence document IDs intersect final heldout documents
selection.training_exposure: Final query text and all 295 documents in final-connected groups are excluded from tokenizer and every training objective. Recipe-development query text and human query/evidence pairs are excluded from all training objectives. The 4,888 eligible corpus documents include 29 recipe-development component documents; the fixed 128-document MLM sample includes 3. This is disclosed tokenizer/unsupervised document-text exposure, not claim/evidence supervision.
selection.unjudged: queries without evidence are excluded from retrieval metric denominators and counted explicitly; no synthetic negatives
selection.weak_pairs: span/section and title-abstract pairs are marked weak and never substituted for evidence annotations
